reviewer: Codex visual review, not human approval
observations: The 2D concept was generated before any skeleton input. Armor, red tabard, gold emblem, round helmet and equipment carry into the state sheets.
Pixel contours and shared material ramps are readable; cloth and plume are redrawn rather than copied from a 3D mesh.
Walk foot placement drifts from the frozen pose guide; some mace positions also exceed the limit.
Attack frame 3 (zero-based) enlarges the mace head from 10 to about 14 native cells; frame 4 crouches more deeply than its skeleton.
Block shield heights drift in frames 1, 3 and 5. Some neck/pelvis/helmet measurements are occluded and remain unverified.
Body proportions look more consistent than the discarded mesh-first sample, but this is not proof of invariant semantic limb dimensions.
measurement_limitations: Manual observations are approximate to one native cell. Near-threshold numeric failures need closer review; limits were not changed to accept them.
next_redraw: Keep the selected 2D design; redraw walk foot contacts and mace grip at the frozen joint positions.
Redraw attack 3 with a foreshortened arm and a 10-cell mace head; redraw attack 4 with a shallower brace.
Lower the shield in block 1/3/5 to its skeleton control and manually inspect obscured anatomy.
